decisions.reason: Replacing identified stock photos changes image sourcing but does not change the requirement that each service have a representative image.
The photo replacements preserve the existing highly visual, image-focused presentation rather than modifying that presentation requirement.
The house subject is established by a separate clause and is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the stock-photo replacement decision does not further change the hero state.
Linking portfolio tiles to the gallery is a separate instruction in the source message and is unaffected by replacing stock photos.
The gallery already requires client portfolio photographs, and the source does not identify the stock-photo replacements as a change to the gallery's source or target photo count.
Replacing stock photos does not change the gallery category tabs or optional other-photography area.
The image replacement decision has no effect on the mobile pricing table interaction.
Changing image assets does not modify whether or how portfolio hover animations operate.
The stock-photo replacements do not change the displayed services, pricing breakdown, selection behavior, or diagram format.
The image replacement decision does not affect the one-time pricing model or pricing-tab visibility.
Replacing stock photos does not logically change the site's responsive behavior across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
The image replacements do not alter homepage button destinations or navigation behavior.
